obligations.expected_behavior: Establish bidirectional Exact Cover for every Atomic Obligation during coverage evaluation.
forbidden_result: An Atomic Obligation has only one-way, partial, or missing Exact Cover.
obligations.observable_result: Each Atomic Obligation is covered by an Exact Cover relation in both directions.
obligations.state_after: Every Atomic Obligation has bidirectional Exact Cover.
obligations.state_before: Atomic Obligation coverage may be absent, partial, or only one-way.
obligations.subject: Atomic Obligation Exact Cover
obligations.trigger: When Exact Cover is evaluated for the obligations.

obligations.expected_behavior: Provide a semantically matching fault or violation witness for every Atomic Obligation during evaluation.
forbidden_result: An Atomic Obligation lacks a witness.
A witness exists but is not semantically matching.
obligations.observable_result: Each Atomic Obligation is associated with a semantically matching fault or violation witness.
obligations.state_after: Every Atomic Obligation has a semantically matching fault or violation witness.
obligations.state_before: Atomic Obligations may have no witness or a semantically mismatched witness.
obligations.subject: Atomic Obligation witness

obligations.expected_behavior: Fail the evaluation whenever any orphan is present.
forbidden_result: The evaluation passes while one or more orphans remain.
obligations.observable_result: The presence of any orphan produces a failed evaluation result.
obligations.state_after: Evaluation is failed for any orphan.
obligations.state_before: One or more orphans may be present in the evaluated set.
obligations.subject: Orphan evaluation outcome
obligations.trigger: When coverage and witness evaluation detects an orphan.
